function use(x) {}

// CASE js_single_update_body_page expect=pass
async function p1(api) {
	let n = 0;
	for (let page = await api.first(); page; n++) {
		use(page);
		page = await api.next(page);
	}
}

// CASE js_single_empty_update_body_page expect=pass
async function p2(api) {
	for (let page = await api.first(); page; ) {
		use(page);
		page = await api.next(page);
	}
}

// CASE js_empty_init_body_page expect=pass
async function p3(api) {
	let page = await api.first();
	for (; page; ) {
		use(page);
		page = await api.next(page);
	}
}
